articles.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
articles.description: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against  humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

articles.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
articles.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

articles.title: Man who attacked nun on CCTV in Jerusalem acquitted on grounds of mental health
articles.description: A Jerusalem court said the Jewish attacker was having a psychotic episode when he assaulted the nun, in an incident which caused outrage.

articles.title: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of French nuclear plant
articles.description: It is the second consecutive year that jellyfish has forced the closure of the Gravelines power station in northern France.
